content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) FUNWAVE-TVD MPI ghost-cell exchange and domain-distribution routines (BSD header L12-L55; per-routine headers credit 02/14/2011 Jeff Harris and 05/01/2011 Fengyan Shi 'implemented into the TVD code' @L61-L62). Four external subroutines, no module wrapper. (1) phi_exch(PHI) (L65-L179): exchanges Nghost-deep ghost strips of REAL(SP) PHI(Mloc,Nloc) with the four Cartesian neighbors (n_west/n_east/n_suth/n_nrth from GLOBAL, communicator comm2d). East-west phase: len=Nloc*Nghost @L79; for each non-MPI_PROC_NULL neighbor posts MPI_IRECV then packs the interior edge columns into send buffers (sWmsg(j,i)=PHI(Ibeg+i-1,j) @L88; sEmsg(j,i)=PHI(Iend-i+1,j) @L102) and posts MPI_ISEND (tag pairs 0/1); MPI_WAITALL @L110; unpacks into ghost columns PHI(Ibeg-i,j)=rWmsg @L115, PHI(Iend+i,j)=rEmsg @L123. North-south phase repeats with len=Mloc*Nghost @L130, row packing (L139, L153), MPI_WAITALL @L161, unpack PHI(i,Jbeg-j)=rSmsg @L166, PHI(i,Jend+j)=rNmsg @L174. (2) phi_exch_variable_length(PHI,Mloc,Nloc,Ibeg,Iend,Jbeg,Jend,Nghost) (L192-L307): identical algorithm but grid extents are INTENT(IN) dummy arguments @L197 (USE GLOBAL restricted to neighbor/comm variables @L194), for exchanging arrays whose shape differs from the default grid; same pack/unpack expressions at L216/L230/L243/L251/L267/L281/L294/L302 with WAITALLs @L238/L289. (3) phi_int_exch(PHI) (L320-L433): INTEGER variant — PHI and all buffers INTEGER (L324, L329-L330), datatype MPI_INTEGER (L339-L412), same two-phase pattern with WAITALLs @L365/L416 (used for MASK-type arrays). (4) DISTRIBUTE_VarGlob(VarGlob,PHI) (L450-L547, ykchoi 08/May/2017 rewrite markers): rank 0 copies VarGlob(MGlob,NGlob) into the padded array PHIGLOB(MGlob+2*Nghost,NGlob+2*Nghost) @L473 and fills the global ghost frame by edge replication (south/north L477-L484, west/east L485-L492); every rank computes its Nghost-shifted global indices Nista=iista+Nghost etc. (L496-L499) which are MPI_Gathered to rank 0 (L503-L510); rank 0 keeps its own block PHI=PHIGLOB(1:Mloc,1:Nloc) @L513 and for irank=1..px*py-1 slices the ghost-inclusive block (istanum=Nistas(irank+1)-Nghost @L518 ... lenx=iendnum-istanum+1 @L523) into buffer xx and mpi_isend+mpi_wait to that rank (L529-L530), while the destination rank computes lenxy=(Niend-Nista+1+2*Nghost)*(Njend-Njsta+1+2*Nghost) (L535-L537) and mpi_irecv's directly into PHI (L539-L540).

verbatim_spans.text: !    phi_exch is the subroutine to exchange variable at processor interface

unresolved: phi_int_exch's header comment @L313 still describes 'phi_exch' (copy-paste); DISTRIBUTE_VarGlob's header block is duplicated twice (L436-L442 and L443-L449, second adds 05/08/2017 Young-Kwang Choi)

E-W buffers are dimensioned (Nloc,Nghost) but indexed (j,i) with j over grid rows (L74-L75 vs L86-L88): correctness of MPI matching relies on both sides using identical linearized order — internally consistent here but the (j,i) convention is opposite to the N-S buffers' (i,j)

DISTRIBUTE_VarGlob consistency: receiver's lenxy (L535-L537, from its own Nista/Niend) must equal sender's lenx*leny (L523-L525, from gathered indices) and PHI(Mloc,Nloc) shape — requires Mloc==iiend-iista+1+2*Nghost globally; no check in this file

Loop indices i,j (lower case, L86-L177 etc.) and I,J (L471-L492) are not declared in any of the four subroutines despite IMPLICIT NONE — they are the shared module scratch variables from PARAM (via USE PARAM/USE GLOBAL)
PHIGLOB @L456 is a full padded global automatic array created on every rank although only rank 0 uses it (L470-L493, L512-L528)

No periodic-wrap logic appears in the exchanges: periodicity is delegated to the Cartesian communicator's neighbor values (n_west etc. from GLOBAL); 'periods' is imported @L194 but unused in this file
Statement-terminating semicolons @L496-L499; req/status arrays are sized 4 while each phase posts at most 4 requests — nreq reset @L81/L132 etc. keeps within bounds
